heading: A conforming runtime may omit RE2-class engine support
text:
### A conforming runtime may omit RE2-class engine support [LNRE.4.1]

A conforming DS runtime **may** be built without linking an RE2-class
regex engine, for a target whose dialect never enables the `regex`
form ([LFCA.13.1], [IRET.23.7]). This is a build-time choice of the
integrator, made once for a deployment target — it is independent of
any single DSC's declared capabilities, in the same way a target's
choice of codegens is independent of any one ruleset.

Such a build **must** still accept every DSC whose `requires` does not
list `regex`, and **must** refuse to load any DSC whose `requires` lists it
([LNRE.4.2]). It offers no partial or degraded regex support: regex
is either fully present, at RE2's full semantics ([LREG.8.1]), or
absent entirely.
